name: Renascience Inc.
summary: Renascience Inc., formed in 2000 with its base in Tokyo, Japan, develops and commercializes pharmaceuticals and medical devices in Japan. Its pipeline includes RS5614, an inhibitor of PAI-1 that has reached Phase 3 trials for several indications, among them melanoma, lung cancer, leukemia and FGF23-related hypophosphatemic rickets. The company is also advancing a disposable ultrafine endoscope, the RS9001, and AI-driven medical and diagnostic tools.
